data.name: Rupkumar
data.gender_notes: Rupkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rup means wealth and Kumar means youth. So, Rupkumar means a wealthy young man. The name Rupkumar carries the meaning “Wealthy, Rich” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Rupkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a wealthy soul who is yet to experience the riches of life.
data.etymology: Rupkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rupkumar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
